hooks.command: echo '═══ Trading Environment Check ═══' && (curl -sf http://localhost:8092/health > /dev/null 2>&1 && echo '✅ Execution Service: UP' || echo '❌ Execution Service: DOWN') && (curl -sf http://localhost:8092/trading/bot-summary/claude-pa 2>/dev/null | python3 -c "import sys,json; d=json.load(sys.stdin); print(f'💰 Claude PA: ${d["available_margin"]:.0f} 可用 | 持仓 {len(d["positions"])}/{d["config"]["max_positions"]} | 日盈亏 ${d["daily_pnl"]["realized"]+d["daily_pnl"]["unrealized"]:.2f}')" 2>/dev/null || echo '⚠️ Claude PA bot: 无法获取状态')
osascript -e 'display notification "$CLAUDE_NOTIFICATION" with title "Claude PA Trading"' 2>/dev/null || true
